record.notes: Published 28 Feb 2025 and effective 1 Sept 2025, the same day as the Measures for Labeling AI-Generated and Synthetic Content (CN-09), whose Art. 11 requires labelling to also meet mandatory national standards. It is a mandatory 'GB' standard, not a recommended 'GB/T' one. The Chinese title covers content generated and synthesised by AI (人工智能生成合成内容); the official English title shortens this to 'content generated by artificial intelligence'. An English-language edition, translated under TC260, was published on 30 Jan 2026.

verification.note: SAMR openstd page (official) and std.samr page stored: number, Chinese and English titles, status 现行 (current), mandatory (强制性), published 2025-02-28, implemented 2025-09-01, the Office of the Central Cyberspace Affairs Commission as competent department and TC260 as executing committee confirmed. The std.samr listing of the English-language edition (published 2026-01-30) is stored, but not its text. The standard's own text is not stored: the online-preview URL returned the same catalogue page, so the summary's description of explicit and implicit labelling methods and its link to the Labeling Measures rest on the 11 Oct 2026 pass. A joint public release with the Labeling Measures on 14 Mar 2025 is in no stored file.

judgment.status_reasoning: The SAMR catalogue gives 实施日期 (implementation date) 2025-09-01 and 标准状态 现行 (current). The date is before today (14 Oct 2026) and no withdrawal (废止) is shown, so the mandatory standard is In force.
judgment.scope_reasoning: In scope with no note: a mandatory national technical standard on labelling AI-generated content.
